businessPurpose: Choose whether the next Debitoren step should be manual UI, template, configuration package, Excel-assisted import, API/AL later, or parked, based on realistic fictional Universaarl customers and current Foundation gaps.
acceptanceCriteria: Decision compares UI, template, configuration package, Excel-assisted import, API/AL and parked route.
